profile.title: Junior Business Analyst | Junior Data Analyst
profile.headline: Turning Data Into Insights. Transforming Ideas Into Solutions.
profile.location: Purwokerto & Jakarta, Indonesia (Open to Hybrid & Remote)
profile.bioSummary: An Information Systems graduate from Telkom University Purwokerto passionate about business analysis, data analytics, and technology-driven solutions. I combine rigorous business process modeling (BPMN 2.0) with quantitative analytical workflows in Python, SQL, and Looker Studio.
bioParagraphs: I am an Information Systems graduate from Telkom University Purwokerto (GPA: 3.69 / 4.00) with a strong foundation built through hands-on internships at government agencies like BPKP Headquarters and academic research initiatives.

As a graduate of both SMK Multimedia and Telkom University's Information Systems program, I bring a rare combination of visual communication sensibility, technical systems architecture, and business requirements engineering.

Whether reviewing organizational workflows for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), conducting aspect-based sentiment analysis with IndoBERT on hospital patient reviews, or building data analytics dashboards in Excel and SQL, I love turning complex ambiguity into structured, actionable business solutions.

Foundational training in digital media, interface design, graphic composition, and user-centric communication.

projects.title: Business Process Analysis & Internship Admission System
projects.role: IT System Intern | Business Process & UI/UX Support
projects.tagline: Supported business process documentation, SOP preparation, and system design coordination for a new internship admission system at BPKP Headquarters.
projects.problemStatement: Legacy internship admission processes across division units involved dispersed email submissions and manual tracking spreadsheets. The objective was to design a unified digital admission flow while maintaining strict data governance without exposing internal confidential data.
projects.methodology: Conducted stakeholder interviews with IT division heads, reviewed existing intake touchpoints, prepared comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), drafted workflow diagrams, and collaborated with developers on UI/UX mockups and wireframes.
results: Successfully mapped end-to-end internship admission lifecycle
Prepared comprehensive SOP documentation adopted for division coordination
Delivered intuitive UI wireframes for BPKP headquarters system deployment

projects.title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis of Google Maps Reviews — Hermina Hospital Purwokerto
projects.tagline: Fine-tuning IndoBERT deep learning model on 3,936 Google Maps reviews and 8,229 aspect-sentiment pairs across 5 hospital service aspects.
projects.problemStatement: Unstructured online patient reviews contain rich qualitative feedback, but aggregate 1-to-5 star ratings obscure specific operational weaknesses in healthcare delivery. Hospital administrators need granular intelligence on individual service aspects.
projects.methodology: Scraped and verified 3,936 Google Maps reviews, annotated 8,229 aspect-sentiment pairs across 5 dimensions (Service, Empathy, Medical Competence, Facilities, Responsiveness), fine-tuned IndoBERT with transformer tokenization, and performed rigorous statistical validation with confusion matrices and F1-score evaluation.
deliverables: Fine-tuned IndoBERT Deep Learning NLP Model
Undergraduate Thesis Manuscript & Visual Research Deck
results: Granular sentiment distribution mapped across 5 dimensions: Service, Empathy, Medical Competence, Facilities, and Responsiveness

aspectMetrics.note: Evaluates physician diagnostic clarity and clinical treatment quality
Measures nurse bedside manner, kindness, and compassionate care
Assesses front-desk administrative intake, registration, and billing flow
Reviews hospital room cleanliness, equipment availability, and parking
Evaluates emergency room triage times and pharmacy queue dwell times

projects.title: RedDoorz Booking Data Analytics
projects.tagline: Collaborative booking data exploration, SQL multi-table querying, and Looker Studio executive dashboard presentation.
projects.problemStatement: Multi-property hospitality networks encounter dynamic occupancy fluctuations, seasonal cancellation surges, and diverse customer channel behaviors that demand data-backed marketing and pricing strategies.
projects.methodology: Imported and sanitized hotel reservation records in Excel and SQL, conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA), formulated SQL analytical queries, built interactive Looker Studio visualizations, and synthesized business insight recommendations.
deliverables: Sanitized Hospitality Booking Dataset & Data Dictionary
SQL Query Scripts (Aggregation, Joins, Window Functions)
results: Created real-time dynamic dashboard for ADR, RevPAR, and lead times
Isolated peak cancellation risk windows to inform deposit policies

projects.title: Plastani — Rice Husk-Based Mulch Plastic Platform
projects.tagline: An educational web platform and marketplace concept connecting prospective agricultural buyers with eco-friendly rice-husk mulch producers.
projects.problemStatement: Agricultural non-biodegradable mulch plastics generate severe microplastic soil degradation. However, smallholder farmers lacked an educational channel and accessible marketplace to procure sustainable rice-husk alternatives.
projects.methodology: Conducted market need assessments, modeled customer and seller user journeys in Miro, drafted comprehensive user stories with acceptance criteria, and designed responsive wireframes and UI prototypes in Figma.
results: Completed end-to-end interactive marketplace concept prototype
Structured transparent supply chain workflow for local mulch producers
Recognized as an exemplary capstone project in sustainable enterprise design
